description: This Java class defines a GUI panel (EngineSnifferStatusPanel) for displaying engine sniffer status information such as mouse coordinates, time, angle, and RPM, including handling mouse movement events and updating labels accordingly.

classes.name: EngineSnifferStatusPanel
classes.description: GUI component representing a status panel that displays real-time engine parameters such as time, angle, RPM, and provides mouse interaction to update these values.

methods.name: mouseMoved
methods.description: Handles mouse move events by updating labels with current mouse position, corresponding time, crank angle, and RPM based on the current translator and revolution log.

methods.name: setTimeAxisTranslator
methods.description: Sets the translator used to convert screen x-coordinate to time.

methods.name: setRevolutions
methods.description: Updates the revolution log with new revolution data for RPM calculation and crank angle display.
